Registration name: MEInivoz
Exhibition name: Paul Ricard ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Jacques Mouchotte (France, before 1988).
Introduced in France by Meilland et Cie in 1993 as 'Paul Ricard'.
Introduced in United States by Conard-Pyle (Star Roses) in 1994 as 'Summer's Kiss'.
Introduced in Australia by Ross Roses in 1995 as 'Spirit of Peace'.
rows.Bloom: Amber. Strong, anise, licorice, sweet fragrance. 45 petals. Average diameter 3.75". Medium-large, very full (41+ petals), borne mostly solitary, rounded bloom form. Prolific, blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Armed with thorns / prickles, upright. Medium, matte, medium green foliage.

Height: 4'11" to 5¼' (150 to 160cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower or garden. Vigorous. produces decorative hips. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
